info.name: IAM Service — Role Management API
info.description:
Exercises every /api/v1/roles endpoint in app/api/v1/routes/roles.py, implemented from Role_API_Specification_Extended.md, plus the pre-existing global (platform-wide) role-assignment contract it didn't touch. Sibling to ../auth, ../users, ../tenants, and ../permissions — kept separate so each can be run/maintained independently.

**Two role systems live under the same /roles prefix:**
1. Tenant-scoped custom roles (this spec) — POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /roles, .../permissions, .../users, .../clone, .../activate, .../deactivate. A role's tenant is resolved from the caller's *session* (`claims.tenant_id`) or an explicit `tenant_id` in the request/query — there's no `organization_id` field anymore.
2. The pre-existing global (platform-wide) catalog — POST /roles/seed, POST/DELETE /roles/{role_id}/assignments, GET /roles/assignments/{user_id} — unaffected by this spec, kept in its original bare-object shape, used by every sibling collection's Setup folder.

**Notes on the implementation vs. the spec doc:**
- `slug` is the wire name; the stored column is still named `code` internally (unrelated to this implementation).
- An explicit `tenant_id` (request body for create, query param for list) lets *any* caller target a tenant other than their session's — necessary because a session's `claims.tenant_id` is only set at login time, and an owner's token often predates the organization they since created/joined. The actual security gate is the require-owner-or-superuser check applied afterward, not session-matching.
- `POST /roles/{role_id}/users` (bulk org-membership role assignment) only works on tenant-scoped roles — global roles 403 there; use POST /roles/{role_id}/assignments (the pre-existing mechanism) for those instead.
- Create's response enriches the spec's example with the full Common Role Object (permissions_count/users_count/created_by/updated_by/timestamps).

**Prerequisites:**
1. Run the service: `uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000`.
2. Create a superuser: `uv run python scripts/create_superuser.py admin@example.com ChangeMe123!` (update `superuser_email`/`superuser_password` below if different).

**Auto token handling:** same pattern as the sibling collections — Login Test scripts capture tokens per actor into collection variables, and a collection-level pre-request script auto-refreshes a near-expired token via POST /auth/refresh before any other request runs.

**Run order matters** — later folders assume earlier ones ran (Setup creates a tenant-bound owner + member; Permissions/Users/Clone folders all act on the role created in folder 1).
